      SELECT concat(index_name,'(',group_concat(column_name ORDER BY seq_in_index),')') AS x

statements.sql:
SELECT string_agg((x)::text, ' ') FROM (
      SELECT concat(index_name,'(',string_agg((column_name)::text, ',' ORDER BY seq_in_index),')') AS x
      FROM (SELECT n.nspname::text AS table_schema, c.relname::text AS table_name, CASE WHEN i.indisprimary THEN 'PRIMARY' ELSE ic.relname::text END AS index_name, (NOT i.indisunique)::int AS non_unique, k.n::int AS seq_in_index, a.attname::text AS column_name FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE n.nspname = 'public') AS statistics WHERE table_name='t' AND index_name<>'PRIMARY'
      GROUP BY index_name ORDER BY index_name) q

SELECT group_concat(x SEPARATOR ' ') FROM (
      SELECT concat(index_name,'(',group_concat(column_name ORDER BY seq_in_index),')') AS x

statements.sql:
SELECT string_agg((x)::text, ' ') FROM (
      SELECT concat(index_name,'(',string_agg((column_name)::text, ',' ORDER BY seq_in_index),')') AS x
      FROM (SELECT n.nspname::text AS table_schema, c.relname::text AS table_name, CASE WHEN i.indisprimary THEN 'PRIMARY' ELSE ic.relname::text END AS index_name, (NOT i.indisunique)::int AS non_unique, k.n::int AS seq_in_index, a.attname::text AS column_name FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid = i.indexrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE n.nspname = 'public') AS statistics WHERE table_name='t' AND index_name<>'PRIMARY'
      GROUP BY index_name ORDER BY index_name) q
